title: Sectionwise acyclicity of finite norm-topological scalar coefficients
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with its extending norm topology. Let $A(S)=C(S,E)$ be the commutative condensed ring of all continuous functions [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring]. Work on the small coherent profinite site of [def-weil-size-convention], with finite jointly surjective covering families, and use internal $A$-modules [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. Write $\mathcal F$ for the underlying abelian sheaf of $A$ and use cohomology over an object [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Then $E$ is complete. For every finite jointly surjective cover $\mathcal U=\{T_i\to V\}$ of profinite sets and every integer $q>0$,
$$\check H^q(\mathcal U,\mathcal F)=0,$$
with the alternating restriction Cech complex of [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex], and for every profinite $V$ one has
$$H^q(V,\mathcal F)=0\qquad(q>0).$$
For any nonnegative injective resolution $A\to I^\bullet$ in internal $A$-modules [def-sp-injective-resolutions], transported to sectionwise modules by [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence], the augmented complex of abelian groups
$$0\longrightarrow C(V,E)\longrightarrow I^0(V)\longrightarrow I^1(V)\longrightarrow\cdots$$
is exact for every profinite $V$. Its augmentation identifies degree-zero cohomology with $C(V,E)$ itself; its positive cohomology is zero. This applies to every such resolution. Empty profinite objects and empty covers of the empty object are included. All functions are continuous with values in the fixed finite extension $E$; no locally constant restriction, norm completion of an algebraic closure, or constant discrete ring replacement is made.

source.place: Tag 03F9 (lemma-cech-vanish-collection) and Tag 03FD (lemma-cohomology-modules-abelian-agree), applied to all profinite objects. Analytic input: literature/bhatt-scholze-pro-etale-topology_arXiv-1309.1198.pdf Lemma 4.3.9(2)–(4), via lem-sfb-normed-scalar-profinite-cech-exact. Original steps 3–4 of lem-sfb-normed-scalar-profinite-hom-acyclic; agent formulation of the finite-family and module-resolution consequences.

proof.text: Completeness is FiniteDimensional.complete over the complete field Q_ell. For a nonempty finite index type apply the scalar Cech vanishing lemma, once with index universe u for the asserted family vanishing, and once with index universe 0 for the coherent covering basis. For an empty index type every tuple-indexed cochain group is subsingleton, hence zero; its homology is zero in every degree, without using joint surjectivity. This edge case is proved by the private scalar_cech_vanishing_with_empty helper.

Apply the profinite finite Cech criterion to the underlying continuous-function sheaf. The categorical criterion is used at the actual coefficient universe u+1, without identifying Profinite with a small category in universe u.

For every chosen injective resolution of the regular module, compare homology of its evaluated complex with abelian right derived evaluation by the internal-module comparison. Transport positive vanishing along that isomorphism.

Evaluation of internal modules is additive and left exact. Map the kernel fork of the given resolution augmentation to obtain an exact short complex with monic augmentation. Convert categorical monicity and exactness to Function.Injective and Function.Exact. For each later position use positive zero homology to obtain exactness of the corresponding short complex. Finally the degree-zero quasi-isomorphism criterion reduces the homology map of the actual augmentation to the same mapped kernel universal property. Thus degree-zero normalization is proved independently of the comparison, and no assumption on abelian injectivity is used.
